title: The Zevrix Tariff Dispute
description: House Zevrix proposes raising tariffs on shard-energy imports through the Obsidian Gate. The Union of Public Tenders objects, claiming it will raise food preservation costs. Kaelrath must weigh trade revenue against public burden.

title: The Bloomshade Water Rights
description: House Maurellien's grove expansion is diverting water from the Bloomshade aqueducts. Residents complain of low pressure. The druids argue their enchanted flora purifies the water downstream. A compromise must be found.
objectives: Consult Mason Brennus on infrastructure options
Mediate between House Maurellien and residents

title: Golem Labor Petition
description: The Blackring Smiths guild petitions the council: golem labor is replacing skilled tradesmen. House Veydran argues golems boost output. The guild demands a 'human-first' crafting quota.
objectives: Issue a decree balancing golem and human labor

title: The Prophecy Archive Proposal
description: Archivist Sybelle requests permission and funding to construct a sealed prophecy vault beneath the Citadel. She claims certain texts are too dangerous for the Crystal Archive. General Varka opposes — he doesn't want 'forbidden knowledge' beneath the seat of power.

title: Festival of the First Flame
description: Brida proposes organizing a city-wide 'Flame Remembers' festival, but the treasury allocation is contested. Each noble house wants their district to host the main event.
objectives: Review budget proposals from each house

title: The Naval Expansion Vote
description: Commander Thera requests a massive budget increase to triple the navy. She claims southern coastal threats are growing. House Zevrix objects — the money should go to trade fleet expansion instead.
objectives: Review intelligence reports on coastal threats
Decide between military or commercial expansion

title: The Bellringer's Silence
description: Bellringer Iros has stopped ringing the council hours. Investigation reveals his core is degrading — he needs maintenance, but the parts require rare Orichalcum scraps. Thalos says replacing him with a new golem would be cheaper.

title: Kindlekin's First Lesson
description: The prototype teacher golem Kindlekin is ready for its first class. But the children are afraid of it. Silvy suggests using illusion magic to make Kindlekin appear friendlier. Thalos insists the children should learn to accept golems as they are.

title: Rats in the Wyrmshadow
description: Giant rats — possibly shard-mutated — have infested the lower levels of the Wyrmshadow Commons. The community kitchens are threatened. The Union of Public Tenders needs help clearing them.

title: The Prismspire Experiment Gone Wrong
description: A magical experiment in Prismspire Heights has created an unstable leyline pocket. Small objects are floating, colors are shifting, and a student is trapped inside a time-dilated bubble.

title: The Stoneheart Market Swindle
description: A merchant in the Embermarket is selling 'genuine Vault ore' at low prices. It's actually painted river rock. Oran Velthyr wants it handled quietly to avoid embarrassing the trade courts.

title: Wyrmling Escape
description: Three juvenile wyrms have escaped the Wyrmflight Spires and are terrorizing the Outer Groves. Mareth is furious — the rookery handlers were negligent. The wyrms must be recaptured alive.

title: The Dockmaster's Dilemma
description: An unmarked vessel has arrived at Flamepier Docks carrying cargo sealed with dreambinding contracts. Dockmaster Ryven can't open or inspect them. The cargo radiates faint shard-energy.
objectives: Decide: impound, release, or investigate further

title: Leyline Ward Failure
description: Leyline wards along the Crystal Archive Ward have failed. Memory-based entities are leaking through. House Theryn's archivists are barricaded inside the Library of Echoes.

title: The Apprentice's Trial
description: Apprentice Velin is preparing for his Memory Smithing trial at the Forge Academy. He needs Memory Ore samples from the Vault of Seven but lacks clearance. He asks Kaelrath to sponsor his access.

title: Overseer Glenda's Selection Problem
description: Overseer Glenda has 50 applicants for 10 Forge Academy slots. She asks Kaelrath to personally evaluate the top candidates. Among them is a child who shows signs of divine flame affinity.

title: The Forbidden Forge
description: Master Artor discovers that students have been secretly using divine flame techniques without supervision. One student's creation — a self-replicating blade — has become unstable.

title: The Dream-Forge Experiment
description: High Enchanter Thalos proposes combining Dreamforging and Memory Smithing to create weapons that respond to their wielder's subconscious. The Forge Academy's safety board is divided.

title: Patrol the Ashwake Spine
description: Captain Rynn reports bandit activity along the Ashwake Caravan Spine. A routine patrol is needed to secure the trade route and reassure caravan masters.

title: The Golem Weapon Test
description: Forge-Sergeant Halvek has developed a new golem-mounted siege weapon. General Varka wants a live-fire test against the old Shardwall defenses.

title: Commander Thera's Ghost Ship
description: Commander Thera's naval patrol has spotted a ghost ship drifting on Emberlake at night. It appears and disappears with the fog. The crew is spooked and morale is dropping.
objectives: Join a night patrol on Emberlake
Determine if it's a threat or an echo

title: The Wyrmwing Aerial Drill
description: Captain Rynn is staging an aerial combat drill with the Wyrmwing Flyers. A wyrm rider is showing signs of bond-sickness. The drill could be dangerous.
objectives: Decide: ground the rider or push through

title: The Fire Dancer's Return
description: Ashryn has returned from the southern desert with a challenge: she wants to formally claim succession rights through a Flamekeeper Trial. This will set a precedent for all of Kaelrath's heirs.
objectives: Decide whether to allow the trial

title: The Forgehand's Rage
description: Reports from a nearby hamlet: Kaelen destroyed a blacksmith's forge in a fit of temper. His strength was far beyond normal for his age — divine blood is manifesting. The hamlet elders are frightened.
objectives: Decide: bring him to Emberheart or let him stay

title: Silviea's Secret
description: Silviea's illusion powers have grown beyond her control. She's creating persistent illusions that people mistake for real — including a phantom version of Kaelrath. Thalos is concerned; Sybelle is fascinated.
objectives: Enroll her in Prismspire or assign a private tutor

title: The Locket in the Market
description: A street urchin named Tharn has been caught pickpocketing in the Obsidian Gate trade courts. When detained, guards found a broken locket bearing Kaelrath's sigil. The boy claims he's nobody.
objectives: Decide: reveal his heritage or protect him with anonymity

title: Emberyn's Song
description: The young bard Emberyn has been singing at the Wyrmshadow community squares. Her voice carries an unusual resonance that lingers in the air. People report feeling 'remembered' — seeing brief flashes of their happiest moments.
objectives: Decide: formal musical education or let the gift develop naturally

title: The Cursed Dreamer
description: Roan's prophetic nightmares have intensified. He dreamed of a wyrm-shaped shadow swallowing the Vault of Seven. The village healer is convinced the boy is cursed. Sybelle wants him brought to the Crystal Archive immediately.
objectives: Decide: bring him to Emberheart or leave him in peace

title: The Burning Child
description: Riven has been found. The silent, burning child was wandering near the Vault of Seven perimeter alone. His footsteps leave scorch marks on stone. He stares at the Vault entrance as if waiting for something.
objectives: Assess his divine connection to the Vault

title: The Little Flame's Birds
description: Tahlia, hidden among Silvara's fae-kin, has accidentally set a flock of songbirds on fire. The birds survived — they're now permanently flame-feathered — but the local druids are alarmed.

title: The Flameway Toll War
description: A fortified toll station on the Flameway Northroad is being operated by an unauthorized militia. They claim jurisdiction from a pre-Emberheart charter. Merchants are paying double tolls.
objectives: Negotiate, buy out, or remove the militia

title: Silkspire Smugglers
description: Illegal dreamglass is being smuggled along the Silkspire Trail, bypassing fae dreambinding contracts. The fae merchants are threatening to close trade entirely unless Emberheart cracks down.

title: The Verdant Cross Creature
description: Something large has been attacking logging crews on the Verdant Cross. House Maurellien's druids say the forest is angry. The loggers say the druids are sabotaging operations.
objectives: Determine if the creature is natural, shard-mutated, or druid-summoned

title: The Ashwake Caravan Ambush
description: A major supply caravan on the Ashwake Spine was ambushed by an organized force — not simple bandits. They used Voidsteel weapons and seemed to know the patrol schedule. There may be a spy in Emberheart.

title: Emberlake Waterway Pirate
description: A single fast vessel has been harassing merchant ships on the Emberlake Waterway. Commander Thera suspects it's a rogue captain from her own past. She refuses the mission — personal history.
objectives: Capture or negotiate with the captain

title: The Crimson Mask Cell
description: Intelligence suggests a Crimson Mask cult cell is operating within Emberheart — worshippers of a distorted, pre-Ascension version of Kaelrath. They're recruiting disaffected residents who feel excluded from the golden age.

title: The Whispering Vault
description: Workers in the Vault of Seven report hearing whispers that respond to questions. The whispers seem to know things that haven't happened yet. Sybelle is alarmed — the Vault may be developing consciousness.
objectives: Attempt to communicate with the whispers

title: The Missing Arcanist
description: A senior Prismspire arcanist has vanished. His quarters are undisturbed but his research notes on 'shard-entropy reversal' are gone. Thalos fears the research could be weaponized.

title: Brida's Bakery Contest
description: Brida is organizing a kingdom-wide baking contest using Flamewheat from the Emberfields. Kaelrath has been volunteered as a judge. The winner gets a royal commission to supply the Citadel kitchens.

title: The Shard-Day Tournament
description: The seasonal Shard-Day tournament is approaching. Knights from House Caldrith, Forge Academy students, and even golem squads will compete. Kaelrath must decide the tournament rules and whether to participate.

title: The Memory Pilgrimage
description: Monthly pilgrims have arrived seeking memory-bound blessings from Kaelrath. Among them is a dying woman who claims Kaelrath once saved her village decades ago — before his Ascension. She wants to remember the truth.
objectives: Use Memory domain to verify the woman's claim
